_readme: Owner-editable. Every value marked ASSUMPTION is unconfirmed by the owner; confirm or change it. targetContributionPerHour = weeklyContributionTarget / (workingDaysPerWeek * workingHoursPerDay).
_weeklyContributionTarget_source: Owner brief: >= £2,000 weekly net contribution across five working days. ASSUMPTION: treated as per driver-week; for the whole business divide by active drivers.
_workingHoursPerDay_source: ASSUMPTION — door-to-door hours a driver can work in a day, including travel and waiting.
_minContributionPerJob_source: ASSUMPTION — floor below which a job is declined regardless of hourly rate.
